test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 22 Jan 2021 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Which of the following is biodegradable?
solution:
The correct answer is **Plants**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Biodegradable materials** are those that can be broken down by natural processes, such as the action of microorganisms.
 
• **Plants** are organic materials that decompose naturally, returning nutrients to the soil.
 
• Biodegradation helps in reducing waste and environmental pollution.
 
• Non-biodegradable materials, like glass and polythene, persist in the environment for a long time, causing harm.

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__**

 
 

 Option
 Details
 
 

 Glass
 Non-biodegradable; takes thousands of years to decompose.
 
 

 Polythene
 Non-biodegradable; contributes to plastic pollution.
 
 

 Aluminium Cans
 Non-biodegradable; recyclable but takes a long time to break down naturally.
